qa_pairs.question: Assume that all the provincial top - scorers admitted by Tsinghua University in 2013 chose the 'Electronic Information Engineering' major at Tsinghua. (Keep 1 decimal place for the answer, and the unit is %)
qa_pairs.explanation: The number of top - scorers admitted by Tsinghua in 2013: 50; The total number of top - scorers in the Electronic Information Engineering major at Tsinghua: 86; Proportion = (Number of top - scorers in 2013 / Total number of top - scorers in the Electronic Information Engineering major from 2000 to 2015) × 100% = 50 / 86 × 100% = 58.1%
